RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, making unlawful sex discrimination virtually impossible to substantiate. An all-female panel selecting a female candidate demonstrates that gender was not a barrier to appointment. 

For a department head role, selection committees frequently prioritize broad people-management and executive experience over advanced academic credentials such as a PhD. Furthermore, a two-week delay for written feedback is standard in hospital human resources administration. 

Questioning the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused specifically on what leadership competencies you can develop for future executive opportunities.
